name: Ghalta the Unstoppable
description: A titanic dinosaur tyrant released from Orazca, the manifestation of nature's consuming hunger, who defended Ixalan and fought Phyrexians when Huatli summoned her.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tetzimoc, Ghalta and Nezahal answer Huatli's call and tear through the Phyrexians in the streets.
timeline.quote: Nezahal wrapped the giant up from legs to wrists

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The elder dinosaurs, including Ghalta, are freed from their stasis within Orazca.
timeline.quote: When the elder dinosaurs were freed from their stasis within Orazca, a truly titanic beast was released

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: An elder dinosaur who fights giant Phyrexians.
